text: came: Or, came to pass. Heb. was
they joined battle: Heb. the battle was spread | the army: Heb. the array
heretofore: Heb. yesterday, or the third day
quit yourselves like men: Heb. be men
is there done: Heb. is the thing
to be delivered: Or, to cry out | came: Heb. were turned
neither did she regard it: Heb. set not her heart
Ichabod: that is, where is the glory? Or, There is no glory | The glory is departed: Or, there is no glory
